claim_scope: Leak-free re-audit of the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch-hardness conformal coverage KPI ONLY, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Does not modify or delete the attacked KPI receipt; supersedes its skill-over-null magnitude claim while confirming its coverage-guarantee gates remain valid under exchangeability. n=58 leak-free observations from a single formulator and a single instrument.
honest_interpretation: LEAK-FREE JACKKNIFE+ RE-RUN of the module's second Phase-0 KPI (purformance-scratch-hardness-conformal-coverage-kpi.v1.json). The receipted KPI's per-iteration n_test (17/27/42) are byte-identical to the LEAKY legacy LOIO fold sizes independently reproduced and refuted by split-integrity-dedup-v1 (2026-07-30) for this module's OTHER two KPIs; this run confirms the conformal KPI was never re-derived under that fix and closes that gap. Re-running jackknife+ nested-LOIO on the SAME leak-free 58-unique-observation / 17-26-15 disjoint-fold partition, same HistGBM hyperparameters (l2_regularization=0.1, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=6, max_iter=300, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0): marginal coverage at alpha=0.10 is 0.9138 (receipted leaky value 0.9535; floor 0.80) and at alpha=0.20 is 0.8103 (receipted leaky value 0.9186; floor 0.60). Both COVERAGE gates still clear their worst-case floors -- expected, since jackknife+'s coverage guarantee is distribution-free and holds under exchangeability regardless of duplicate rows; duplicates do not violate exchangeability. Hostile-null y-shuffle coverage is 0.9483 (floor 0.80, also clears). BUT the SKILL claim riding on the guarantee -- hostile_null_width_inflates_over_real_signal, i.e. that the base learner demonstrably extracts out-of-sample signal beyond the coverage guarantee alone -- PASSES -- survives leak removal: the leak-free width-inflation ratio is 1.5446x (receipted leaky value 1.758x; target >=1.10x). Leak-free real-signal median interval width is 8.86 N (receipted leaky value 7.31 N); the leaky KPI's narrow intervals were partly an artifact of the model recognizing duplicated iteration-2 rows verbatim inside iteration-3's training fold, producing artificially small LOO residuals for those specific held-out points. This is the SAME memorization mechanism split-integrity-dedup-v1 found for point R2 (HistGBM 0.8555 -> -0.0469), now shown to also have inflated this module's SECOND independently-receipted KPI, via a different summary statistic (interval width / skill-over-null, not point R2).

hostile_null.protocol: y shuffled once with np.random.default_rng(0) applied to the leak-free 58-row target vector; features and iteration grouping preserved; jackknife+ recomputed at alpha=0.10

protocol.inner_method: jackknife+ (Barber, Candes, Ramdas, Tibshirani 2021, Ann. Statist. 49(1):486-507, Algorithm 1); leave-one-training-observation-out refits nested inside each outer LOIO fold
protocol.outer_split: leave-one-iteration-out over 58 unique observations, each assigned to its FIRST iteration of appearance (identical partition to split-integrity-dedup-v1)
protocol.quantile_convention: lower = floor(alpha*(n+1))-th smallest of {pred_-i(x)-R_i}; upper = ceil((1-alpha)*(n+1))-th smallest of {pred_-i(x)+R_i}

refutation_criterion: Leak-free re-run breaches ANY of: (a) alpha=0.10 marginal coverage < 0.80; (b) alpha=0.20 marginal coverage < 0.60; (c) hostile-null alpha=0.10 coverage < 0.80; (d) hostile-null/real-signal median width inflation ratio < 1.10 (no demonstrable out-of-sample skill beyond the coverage guarantee once duplicate rows are removed).
